'''Corey Keller''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Manitoba Provincial Championship]] on 20 May 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit with SA and Mains (Goo Nee Tay start)]], according to Robert Dean's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d817">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-28-winnipeg-manitoba-5-20-00d817/ winnipeg-manitoba-5-20-00], DeckTech (Robert "The Tick" Dean, 28 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-28-winnipeg-manitoba-5-20-00d817/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
